description: Shared Express API for VaporRank + BurnRate.lol. Namespaced routers: /api/vapor/*, /api/burn/*, /api/billing/*.
name: @vaporrank/api

scripts.build: tsc && npm run copy:fixtures && npm run copy:fonts
scripts.copy:fixtures: mkdir -p dist/test/fixtures && cp src/test/fixtures/*.html src/test/fixtures/*.json dist/test/fixtures/ 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.copy:fonts: mkdir -p dist/assets/fonts && cp src/assets/fonts/*.ttf dist/assets/fonts/ 2>/dev/null; true
